$comment: The path and schemas GET /api/v1/search/garages adds to apps/api/openapi.json, in the form @nestjs/swagger 12.0.2 writes them (compare /api/v1/brands and BrandPageDto there). The committed document and libs/data-access are regenerated with `npx nx run data-access:generate`, never edited by hand; CI's Contract check (scripts/contract-check.sh) fails when they are stale.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: The brand, by its catalogue id

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page; opaque

400.description: validation_failed: brandId missing or not a uuid; invalid_cursor: not a page of this search

404.description: not_found: no brand with that id

stance.description: The garage's answer for the brand; unstated when it has not marked it

worksOn.description: Approved garages that work on the brand, over everything found

doesNotTake.description: Approved garages that refuse the brand or have not marked it, over everything found

items.description: Garages that work on the brand first, then the rest; inside a group by name, then id; 20 at most
